description: Download the chronology of one list as a table (DOCX or CSV): a row per fact on the list in the order it happened (the date as precisely as it is known: day, month or year; undated facts last), the fact, the document it first comes from with its page, and the claims of the verified documents that cite it with the verdict as reviewers see it now. Refused, never cut, when the list holds more facts or verified documents than one export reads.

alternative.limitation: returns the same facts, sources and citing claims page by page as JSON; the downloadable table is not produced
